text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

words.gloss_range: delayed sequence and discourse escalation, opening the seizure as a measured sequel after warning rather than an immediate result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: close result or inference particle introducing the evaluative question
completed first-person seizure after the delayed opening

words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens the ayah as delayed consequence, so the seizure clause that follows is heard as the next stage after warning history, not as a sudden unrelated scene. Its separate word-form gives the transition its own beat before {{ar:أَخَذْتُ}} ({{tr:akhadhtu}}), while the later {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) tightens the movement from seizure into assessment. Even the slower nasal close of {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) can support that paced entry, though the grammatical payoff is the delayed sequencing of the whole seizure clause.

topics.headline: delayed sequel after warning history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment is introduced as a measured sequel after disclosure, not as an isolated or instant reaction.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following seizure clause, and the local clause sequence supports delayed consequence after the prior proof-delivery boundary.

topics.headline: delayed opening versus tight result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a paced moral movement: delay before the seizure, then quick inference into the final question.
topics.reason: The opening connector is an independent word, while the later result particle is prefixed to the interrogative and introduces the evaluative clause.

topics.headline: sound supports the delayed entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the recited opening slow before the hard onset of the seizure, without making sound the basis of the syntax.
topics.reason: The sound observation coheres with the particle's pacing but is kept as acoustic support rather than an independent grammatical claim.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person seizure of a conduct-defined object, with grasp and accountability pressure but not an adoptive or merely abstract legal form
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, seizing, and holding accountable; local Form I and the explicit object select direct punitive seizure while liability remains a live pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the direct object defined by completed disbelief

words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذْتُ}} ({{tr:akhadhtu}}) makes the delayed consequence a completed first-person act: the speaker takes hold of {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:alladhīna kafarū}}), so the event is not impersonal disaster. The Form I verb keeps the action direct, while the root field of taking and holding to account makes the grasp punitive rather than neutral acquisition. The supplied parallel at 7:96 ties seizure to earned conduct, and the same-surah return in 35:45 reframes this concrete taking as accountable taking-to-task. Its first-person suffix also anticipates the possessed close in {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}), binding act and verdict to the same voice.

topics.headline: completed speaker-act with explicit object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seizure is voiced by the divine speaker and falls directly on the group defined by denial.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect first-person singular and transitive with the relative clause as its explicit object.

topics.headline: grasp becomes punitive accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees punishment as an accountable grasp after warning, not as neutral taking or abstract liability alone.
topics.reason: V4 has no guardrail rows for this root, so the coherent CRITICAL root pressure is preserved but limited by the local Form I transitive frame.

topics.headline: seizure joins denial and later accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this seizure as part of a wider pattern where denial becomes earned accountability, including the same-surah accountability wording in 35:45 and the earned-deeds parallel in 7:96.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows and root-pair rows are concrete and do not override the local parse.

topics.headline: seizure sets up evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as the hinge between delayed consequence and the final demand to assess the speaker's repudiation.
topics.reason: The seizure clause is complete before the resultive question, and the first-person marking links the opening act to the possessed final noun.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative head functioning as the direct object head, completed by the following denial clause into a behavior-defined class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed plural denial that supplies the relative clause content
the governing verb that assigns object role to the relative head

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is the object head after {{ar:أَخَذْتُ}} ({{tr:akhadhtu}}), even though its indeclinable form does not display accusative case. Its meaning waits for {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}), so the seized object is not an ethnic name or vague crowd but a definite class identified by completed denial. The order lets the listener first register the object group, then hear the conduct that makes it liable.

topics.headline: relative head carries object role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative pronoun is syntactically the seized object, even without visible case marking.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the relative phrase as the explicit object of the first-person verb.

topics.headline: identity completed by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar turns an act of denial into the group's identifying label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is definite but semantically incomplete until the following verb supplies the defining content.

words.gloss_range: completed communal denial in a relative clause; objectless locally, so the refusal remains broad across disclosed truth rather than naming one rejected item
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, rejection, ingratitude, disavowal, and other distant branches; local Form I selects culpable denial, with covering and ingratitude pressure after disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) completes the relative phrase by naming the seized group through completed communal denial. Because the verb has no explicit object here, the refusal is not narrowed to one named item; after disclosed proofs, the root's covering and ingratitude pressure makes the denial feel like covering over what had been made visible. The recognition-denial pattern in 16:83 sharpens the reversal, because human refusal to recognize is answered here by the possessed counter-refusal of {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}). The form remains Form I denial, not expiatory covering or caused unbelief.

topics.headline: perfect plural defines the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as completed communal conduct embedded inside the seized object's grammar.
topics.reason: The plural verb agrees with the relative head and functions as the relative clause that defines the object.

topics.headline: objectless denial remains broad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guilt is not restricted to one named denied object; the refusal remains broad after disclosure.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has no explicit object, and the contextual profile shows objectless use is ordinary for this root-form.

topics.headline: covering disclosed truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears disbelief as culpable covering and ingratitude toward disclosed proof, not neutral lack of information.
topics.reason: V4 supports covering, rejection of truth, and ingratitude branches, while local Form I and context select denial rather than distant concrete or expiatory branches.

topics.headline: human denial meets divine repudiation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah staging a reversal: human refusal is answered by a stronger possessed divine repudiation, with 16:83 sharpening the recognition-denial contrast.
topics.reason: The local phrase places denial before the final repudiation, and the supplied intertext and sound rows preserve a concrete refusal-to-counter-refusal payoff.

words.gloss_range: close result and inferential pivot, prefixed to the interrogative while governing the whole evaluative question

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: delayed sequence before the seizure clause
the completed seizure from which the question draws inference

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is prefixed to {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}), but its force reaches over the whole question that follows. It makes the evaluative clause an immediate inference from {{ar:أَخَذْتُ}} ({{tr:akhadhtu}}), not a new topic. Set against opening {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}), it controls the ayah's pacing: delayed seizure, then tight assessment.

topics.headline: result particle governs evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final question as the direct consequence and assessment of the completed seizure.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the result clause and attaches to the interrogative while the whole question depends on the prior seizure clause.

topics.headline: connector fused to assessment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears consequence and question arrive together as one compact pivot.
topics.reason: The local input splits the particle from the interrogative for analysis, but the surface phrase is pronounced as a compact prefixed unit.

topics.headline: delayed sequence tightens into inference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two particles shaping moral timing: waiting after warning, then immediate evaluation after seizure.
topics.reason: The contrast is locally visible between the opening delayed connector and the resultive particle before the question.

words.gloss_range: fronted manner or state interrogative functioning as the predicate-like complement of the copular clause, asking for assessment of the final possessed repudiation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: copular perfect linking the question to the subject
the possessed repudiation whose quality is assessed

words.prose: {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) stands before {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) as the fronted predicate-like question word, so the listener is pushed to assess quality before the subject {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}) arrives. After the seizure has already been reported, the question asks what the repudiation proved like, not whether it happened. Its rhetorical force turns report into a demand for recognition, with the repeated onset across {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) and {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) making the evaluative hinge audible.

topics.headline: fronted quality question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that quality is foregrounded before the possessed repudiation is named.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the interrogative as the fronted predicate of the copular clause and scopes it over the ending.

topics.headline: question demands recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as a witness-demand after evident consequence, not as a request for unknown information.
topics.reason: The preceding seizure supplies the event, so the interrogative asks for assessment of its manifested quality.

topics.headline: repeated onset binds the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the evaluative hinge cohere as the repeated onset carries the question into the copular verb.
topics.reason: The sound observation follows the adjacent surface forms and supports the already established evaluative transition.

words.gloss_range: perfect copular verb linking the fronted how-question to the singular verbal-noun subject, making the repudiation a retrospectively established outcome
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, coming-to-be, temporal predication, state, place or rank, and other peripheral branches; local use selects copular past predication and realized outcome

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular verbal-noun subject of the copular clause

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) links fronted {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) with {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}), so the final noun is not another object of seizure but the subject whose quality is examined. Its perfect form makes the response retrospectively established: the question asks what the repudiation proved to be after history displayed it. The same-surah recurrence of {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) keeps this in the surah's language of what proves or stands true, and the long ā of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) descends into the ī of {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}) at the close. The broader root of being and occurrence supports that realized-outcome force here, while causative formation, place, suretyship, and other distant branches are not locally selected.

topics.headline: copular frame makes verdict evaluable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from seizure to verdict, with the final repudiation evaluated as subject rather than seized as object.
topics.reason: The local syntax is a deficient copular construction with a fronted predicate and a singular verbal-noun subject.

topics.headline: proved-to-be outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repudiation as an already manifested outcome available for recognition, not as an open future threat.
topics.reason: V4 supports being, occurrence, and past predication; the local perfect copular frame selects proved-to-be force while excluding unrelated branches.

topics.headline: seizure becomes evaluated state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structure turning a completed act into a recognized state of divine response.
topics.reason: The prior perfect seizure and the later perfect copular verb form a local action-to-outcome sequence.

topics.headline: surah state-language and closing cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this copular beat within the surah's recurring language of realized states and hear it descend into the possessed closing noun.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows frequent root recurrence, and the acoustic row follows the local final phrase without altering the grammar.

words.gloss_range: possessed verbal-noun repudiation, locally the speaker's punitive response whose quality is assessed after seizure
words.root_gloss_range: non-recognition, denial, disavowal, disapproval, severity, making unrecognized, condemned wrong, and hostile opposition; local seizure context selects severe divine repudiation rather than mere unfamiliarity or unrelated branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: copular perfect making the noun the evaluated subject
connected recitation realization that makes first-person possession audible
paused recitation realization closing on the bare r-sound

words.prose: {{ar:نَكِيرِ}} ({{tr:nakīri}}) is the closing subject of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), not another object of seizure. As a possessed verbal noun, it names the speaker's own repudiating response, with the final kasra or connected {{ar:نَكِيرِي}} ({{tr:nakīrī}}) making that possession audible; in pause, the stopped {{ar:نَكِيرْ}} ({{tr:nakīr}}) can close on the bare r-sound before continuation extends into first-person possession. The root field moves from non-recognition and denial into severe repudiation here: after {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}), human refusal is answered by divine counter-refusal, and 16:83 sharpens that recognition-denial reversal. The final word therefore lands the ayah on measured, possessed verdict rather than on the seizure alone.

topics.headline: possessed repudiation belongs to the speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing verdict is not generic rejection but the same speaker's possessed repudiation.
topics.reason: The possessive reading and first-person speaker linkage favor subjective possession, not rejection directed toward the speaker.

topics.headline: verbal noun is evaluated subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees repudiation named as the event-quality being measured by the how-question.
topics.reason: The noun is the subject of the copular clause and is maṣdar-like rather than a finite action.

topics.headline: non-recognition becomes punitive counter-refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the non-recognition field sharpen into divine repudiation of those who refused disclosed truth.
topics.reason: V4 supports non-recognition, denial, severity, and condemnation branches; the local seizure context selects punitive repudiation and leaves unrelated branches inactive.

topics.headline: human denial answered by possessed verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a semantic handoff: human denial is answered by divine repudiation, with 16:83 making recognition followed by denial a concrete parallel.
topics.reason: The concrete 16:83 rows and the local denial-to-repudiation sequence support the reversal without changing the local grammar.

topics.headline: qiraat and sound mark possession at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the close either stop hard or extend into the first-person sound, making ownership of the verdict part of the acoustic landing.
topics.reason: The qiraat and waqf rows clarify the audible possession while the local grammar keeps the noun possessed in the closing clause.

topics.headline: proof history lands in direct verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah as a framed movement from prior proof through first-person seizure to direct first-person verdict.
topics.reason: The boundary rows cohere with the local first-person markers and the transition from proof-delivery context to punitive aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2, 4, and 7 join first-person taking, the deniers as its object, and the final nakir question.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking is specified as accountability and capture, disbelief as active obstruction of truth, and nakir as corrective rejection of a reprehensible act. The question points to the correction as something manifested in effects, not merely announced as a verdict.

activation_trace.role: This taking calls someone to account for an offense, making the first-person action a culpability-linked apprehension.
This disbelief obstructs and denies truth, specifying the conduct for which the object group is apprehended.
This nakir rejects and checks an ugly act, giving the seizure a corrective as well as punitive function.

changed_reading.before: God punished a group of disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a targeted apprehension for active denial, then makes the enacted correction itself the object of the hearer's attention.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object at word 4 is defined by covering or denial, while word 7 can name nonrecognition and a change into an unfamiliar or unwelcome state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A lexical reversal links the deniers' covering of truth to a taking that removes their control and ends in nakir: denial rebounds as loss of recognition, and a familiar order becomes alien or abhorrent.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies acquisition and control of the object, allowing the reversal to become an imposed loss of the deniers' prior control.
This branch contributes literal covering, casting denial as an act that hides what should have remained visible.
This branch contributes failed recognition and disavowal, making nakir answer the group's own epistemic posture.
This branch changes a thing until it is no longer familiar or welcome, supplying the experiential reversal produced by the taking.

changed_reading.before: Nakir is only a synonym for punishment.
changed_reading.after: Nakir can also be the counter-form of their denial: the covering group is taken into an exposure that makes its once-familiar order unrecognizable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from word 2 to the how-was construction at words 5-6 and nakir at word 7 presents a completed event for retrospective inspection.
baseline_models.mechanism: Capture occurs in narrated time, while nakir carries severity and strangeness. The final question therefore asks about the event's manifested quality and turns a past seizure into an exemplary scene.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies concrete capture, giving the narrated event a visible action rather than an abstract judgment.
This branch locates occurrence in time, making the question retrospective and historically inspectable.
This branch supplies a severe, difficult, and strange event, defining what the retrospective question asks the hearer to register.

changed_reading.before: The closing question merely intensifies a threat.
changed_reading.after: The question directs attention to the historical form and felt severity of an already manifested capture, making the event evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier taking is a deliberate designation of an enemy, followed by a call intended to make a party become companions of the Blaze. The focus taking can consequently be read as the answering apprehension at the end of a chosen allegiance.

activation_trace.role: This derived taking adopts a designation for oneself, supplying the deliberate stance-taking that begins the reciprocal arc.
This branch draws others by a verbal call, functioning as recruitment into the chosen party.
This occurrence or becoming in time supplies the intended result of that recruitment.
The focus branch turns the earlier chosen stance into a later concrete apprehension.

structural_cues: 35:6 couples enemy-designation with recruitment toward a resulting affiliation; 35:26 repeats taking with God as first-person agent and the deniers as object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two contextually different takings plus a call-to-become sequence; I infer a reciprocal arc in which chosen allegiance culminates in apprehension. A live alternative is that the repeated root provides cohesion without making the punishment reciprocal.

changed_reading.before: The taking is a one-directional punitive act detached from prior choices.
changed_reading.after: The taking answers a prior act of taking sides: a deliberately entered allegiance matures into being taken and held to its chosen trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: An evil deed is cosmetically presented and then judged good. That explicit inversion activates nakir as a forceful de-normalization: the taking does not merely hurt but breaks a false regime of recognition.

activation_trace.role: This branch makes something appear attractive, supplying the cosmetic operation that masks the deed's value.
This branch supplies inward opinion and evaluation, locating the distortion in judgment rather than eyesight alone.
This branch sets good against ugly, providing the value polarity that the decorated perception reverses.
The focus branch changes the familiar into an unwelcome unknown, functioning as the collapse of the false evaluation.

structural_cues: 35:8 grammatically makes the same bad deed the object of beautification, seeing, and evaluation as good; the focus closes with a question about nakir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete bad-to-good perceptual inversion; I infer that nakir reverses that normalization by making the consequences experientially alien and undeniable. The live alternative is that 35:8 diagnoses denial while focus nakir remains punishment without an epistemic function.

changed_reading.before: Nakir adds emotional force to capture.
changed_reading.after: Nakir also corrects a manufactured perception: what had been made to look good is forcibly returned to the category of the unacceptable and strange.

context_deltas.mechanism: Called partners neither hear effectively nor answer, and finally repudiate the association claimed with them. This social failure activates focus nakir as counter-repudiation: the divine response exposes and rejects the relation on which the deniers relied.

activation_trace.role: This branch directs a verbal appeal toward another, supplying the attempted relation with the claimed partners.
This branch treats hearing as understanding and compliance; the verse's negation makes the appeal functionally unheard.
This branch supplies a reply to speech, and its negation marks the claimed relation as unable to answer.
This branch supplies repudiation and detachment, making the partners themselves disown the association.
This branch contributes a claimed share or partnership, identifying the social bond that is repudiated.
The focus branch contributes denial and nonrecognition, allowing divine nakir to answer the failed alliance with a definitive counter-repudiation.

structural_cues: 35:14 moves from appeal, through failed hearing and response, to the partners' future disavowal; 35:26 names the seized group by the same denial root and ends in nakir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed relational response and explicit disavowal; I infer that focus nakir is not only pain but God's answering rejection of the false claim. The alternative is that the disavowal only removes imagined aid and does not color nakir itself.

changed_reading.before: The seized group suffers an impersonal sanction.
changed_reading.after: The seizure also enacts relational exposure: the alliance they asserted disowns them, and divine nakir becomes the final rejection of that false bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context presents removal, arrival, creation, and newness as one ordered sequence. Focus taking can therefore function not only as arrest but as removal of a failed occupant so that another created order may follow.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies departure and passing away, making the existing group removable from its position.
This branch supplies arrival, providing the positive phase that follows removal.
This branch brings a created order into being, identifying what can occupy the space opened by removal.
This branch supplies newness after a break, turning removal into a discontinuous replacement mechanism.
The focus branch gathers and takes control of the deniers, supplying the removal phase of the contextual sequence.

structural_cues: 35:16 coordinates removal and the arrival of a new creation in a single conditional sequence; 35:26 narrates a completed taking of an earlier denying group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remove-then-bring-new syntax; I infer that the focus seizure can instantiate the removal side of replacement. The live alternative is that 35:16 states general creative power while 35:26 remains solely punitive capture.

changed_reading.before: Taking means detaining or destroying offenders in place.
changed_reading.after: Taking can also clear a failed historical occupancy, making the seizure one phase in removal and replacement rather than an isolated arrest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Liability is figured as a heavy load that cannot be transferred even to kin, while purification returns to the self. The focus seizure consequently attaches to each actor's own burden rather than to inherited or contagious group identity.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies a weighty burden, materializing liability as something borne by its owner.
This branch bears an entrusted burden, and the verse's negation blocks its transfer to another bearer.
This branch supplies kinship proximity, showing that even the strongest ordinary transfer relation cannot move the load.
This branch identifies the very self or entity, locating both purification and liability in the individual actor.
The focus accountability branch attaches apprehension to the offense borne by the seized subjects themselves.

structural_cues: 35:18 repeatedly negates burden transfer and closes its purification clause with benefit returning to the self; 35:26 specifies the seized group by its own action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable burden and self-returning purification; I infer the same liability architecture for the focus seizure. The alternative is that the plural group remains the only operative unit in 35:26 despite individual accountability elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports collective punishment of a labeled population.
changed_reading.after: The collective scene is composed of nontransferable accounts: each seized denier is apprehended with a burden that neither kin nor group membership can carry away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah layers messengers, clarifying signs, writings, and illumination under repeated falsification. The focus then-clause reads as the terminal move of an extended disclosure-and-refusal process, not an unannounced seizure.

activation_trace.role: This branch attributes falsehood to a message or messenger, supplying the repeated refusal that persists through disclosure.
This branch supplies both envoy and communicated message, establishing an accountable channel of warning.
This branch discloses meaning through speech or sign, making the evidence explanatory rather than merely present.
This branch supplies written records and books, adding durable textual witness to the disclosure sequence.
This branch supplies illumination, casting the final book as evidence that should make recognition possible.
The focus denial branch names the settled response to the accumulated disclosure.
The focus accountability branch makes taking the consequence that follows persistent falsification of disclosed evidence.

structural_cues: 35:25 is the immediate antecedent and accumulates four modes of disclosure before 35:26 begins with a temporal then.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence and escalating evidence; I infer that the temporal link marks culmination after refused warning. The alternative is a looser historical chronology in which the evidence list and seizure are adjacent but not procedurally staged.

changed_reading.before: The seizure appears sudden and grounded only in the label of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The seizure is the final stage of a documented process: message, clarification, writing, and illumination are repeatedly falsified before accountability takes hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later consequence is neither terminated nor lightened; it answers action with its result, elicits cries for rescue, and must be tasted as experience. Focus taking can thus be a threshold into sustained consequence rather than the whole consequence in one instant.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies completion and ending; its negation prevents the consequence from terminating in release.
This branch reduces a weight or load; its negation makes the experienced burden unrelieved.
This branch matches an act with its due return, supplying the accountability relation behind the sustained state.
This branch supplies an urgent appeal for rescue, showing the consequence as consciously endured.
This branch makes a thing known by undergoing it, turning nakir from report into lived proof.
The focus capture becomes the entry point that places the subject inside the later unrelieved experience.

structural_cues: 35:36-37 denies termination and relief, then gives the subjects direct speech and an imperative of experience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustained, consciously experienced consequence; I infer that focus capture opens that state rather than exhausting it. A live alternative is that 35:26 refers to worldly historical seizure and 35:36-37 offers only an eschatological analogue.

changed_reading.before: The taking and nakir are a single completed blow.
changed_reading.after: The taking is a threshold: nakir unfolds as an unrelieved state whose truth is learned by experience after capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Evil plotting decays, repeated disbelief increases only aversion and loss, and the evil scheme encloses its own people. Focus taking can therefore be the divine closure of a consequence already returning upon and accumulating around its makers.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies ruin and corruption, making the plot's own operation decay rather than prosper.
This repeated truth-denial is grammatically placed against its actor, supplying the input that rebounds.
This branch supplies growth and increase, turning disbelief into an accumulating process rather than a static label.
This branch supplies intense aversion toward ugliness, naming one product generated by the accumulating denial.
This branch supplies general diminution, making the second product a progressive loss of capacity or standing.
This branch makes evil descend upon and surround its source, completing the return loop around the plotters.
The focus accountability branch closes the accumulating return by apprehending those on whom their conduct has settled.

structural_cues: 35:10 makes the plot perish, 35:39 twice restricts increase to adverse products, and 35:43 restricts the scheme's enclosure to its own people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, adverse accumulation, and enclosure of the maker; I infer a causal feedback path ending in focus apprehension. The alternative is that these are three independent descriptions of externally imposed punishment rather than one returning mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God's seizure arrives from outside an otherwise successful course of denial.
changed_reading.after: The seizure seals a self-returning process: denial grows only loss, the plot decays, and its evil closes around its authors until they are apprehended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same sovereign agency holds the heavens and earth against displacement and is immediately characterized by forbearance and forgiveness. Focus taking can therefore be a selective restraining act within maintained order, not indiscriminate destructive force.

activation_trace.role: This branch holds and confines what might move, supplying sovereign restraint as an order-maintaining action.
This branch departs from a place or state; the holding prevents that destabilizing displacement.
This branch supplies deliberate patience and self-restraint, qualifying sovereign power with postponed reaction.
This branch shields an offender from an offense's effect, adding protection and remission to the restraint model.
The focus capture becomes one selective use of the grasp that elsewhere prevents a wider collapse.

structural_cues: 35:41 places cosmic holding, prevented displacement, forbearance, and forgiveness in one sentence, counterbalancing the focus's completed capture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a common agent, restraint against collapse, and patient forgiveness; I infer an analogy between cosmic holding and selective human apprehension. The alternative is that preservation and punishment display separate powers without defining one another.

changed_reading.before: Taking is sheer destructive release of power.
changed_reading.after: Taking is a bounded restraint within an order continuously held from collapse, exercised by an agent whose power also includes patience and remission.

context_deltas.mechanism: An invariant historical path is followed by a command to travel and inspect how earlier peoples ended, even though they possessed concentrated strength and could not escape pursuit. The focus how-was question becomes an empirical prompt whose answer is distributed across visible historical outcomes.

structural_cues: The same how-was construction appears at focus words 5-6 and at 35:44 words 6-7; the latter explicitly directs travel, inspection, and comparison with predecessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal recurrence, an invariant path, and an inspection command; I infer that the focus question expects an evidence-based historical answer. The alternative is that the shared construction is rhetorical intensification without a formal cross-reference.

changed_reading.before: The final question is answered only by fear or imagination.
changed_reading.after: The question asks for historical verification: travel, inspect the outcomes, and recognize a recurring apprehension that greater strength did not evade.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing counterfactual says comprehensive accountability-taking for what people acquired would leave no creature, but actual action is delayed to a fixed term and governed by insight into the servants. The focus past seizure is therefore selective and timed rather than an automatic immediate response to every offense.

activation_trace.role: This branch makes taking accountability for offense, directly restating the focus action in a universal counterfactual.

structural_cues: 35:45 contrasts a universal if-clause with actual postponement, repeats the taking root from the focus, and ends the surah with a fixed term and discerning sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a universal counterfactual, actual delay, and an appointed term; I infer that 35:26 records a selectively matured case of accountability. The alternative is that 35:45 only explains present non-punishment and does not qualify the earlier historical seizure.

changed_reading.before: The focus suggests that denial mechanically triggers immediate seizure.
changed_reading.after: The completed seizure is one timed selection within broad forbearance: universal immediate accounting would erase life, so apprehension waits until an appointed account matures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders judgment through bodily contest rather than courtroom or decree. It remains anchored in three focus branches that combine a grappling hold, disavowal, and open hostility. Downstream prose should call it an embodied metaphor for decisive capture, not a symmetrical struggle between equal agents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 can carry a wrestler's hold, word 4 can carry repudiation, and word 7 can carry hostile confrontation.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies the gripping hold of a bodily contest, making the first-person taking an embodied decisive restraint.
This branch supplies repudiation and withdrawal from relation, giving the confrontation its adversarial posture.
This branch supplies active hostility and combat, extending the capture image into resolved confrontation.

changed_reading.before: Judgment descends as an impersonal decree.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse compresses repudiation into an embodied confrontation whose decisive move is a capturing hold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries water-holding and flow-control images into a verse about people. It remains anchored in the focus taking branch and two contextual holding-place branches. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for bounded containment and stabilization, never as literal hydraulic semantics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 has a branch for a basin-like place that gathers what would otherwise disperse, while word 7 can mark a change into an unwelcome state.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies a bounded place that gathers and retains water, lending the taking a material shape of containment.
This branch supplies a place that holds fluid or fixes what is within it, sharpening the context's open-versus-hold control into bounded flow.
The same holding-place branch is activated by cosmic retention, giving the containment image an order-preserving scale.
This branch supplies an adverse state-change, allowing containment to function as correction of destabilizing conduct rather than storage alone.

changed_reading.before: Taking is imagined only as a blow or removal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, taking gathers and restrains destabilizing agents within a bounded hold so that a wider order does not disperse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the remote lunar-station branch of taking into historical accountability. It remains anchored by that focus branch and by the context's moon, ordered running, and fixed terms. Downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal analogy for phased arrival, not claim that the focus explicitly refers to astronomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 has a branch in which the moon takes a station night by night, and the focus temporal sequence can be heard as arrival at a decisive phase.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies the moon's nightly taking of a station, offering a phased itinerary for the focus action.
This branch supplies the visible moon and its light, giving the remote focus branch an actual contextual celestial anchor.
This branch supplies continuous running, turning stations into an ordered temporal course rather than static locations.
This branch supplies a fixed temporal endpoint, giving the celestial course an appointed destination.
The repeated fixed-term branch transfers appointed timing from cosmic motion to delayed human accountability.

changed_reading.before: Then simply orders two past events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, then marks arrival at an appointed station in a longer ordered course, with seizure occurring when the account reaches its phase.

strongest_changes: The focus seizure became a culpability-linked apprehension after layered disclosure, with each burden remaining nontransferable.
Nakir gained an epistemic and relational function: it reverses beautified misperception and answers false alliances with counter-repudiation.
Punishment became a feedback mechanism in which denial accumulates loss, plotting decays, and evil encloses its makers before apprehension.
The how-was question became historically inspectable through the recurring path and the command to examine predecessors' outcomes.
The closing counterfactual revised seizure into a selective, delayed act within wider forbearance rather than an automatic immediate response.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by repeated taking, denial, occurrence, and how-was constructions, but its most distinctive activations came from reversals: chosen allegiance answered by apprehension, false recognition broken by nakir, self-protective plotting returning on its makers, and destructive power reframed by cosmic holding and delay. Material basin and lunar-station branches remained live only as explicitly contained analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Nakir may foreground corrective censure, experiential strangeness, counter-disavowal, or hostile confrontation; the focus alone does not force one of these branches to exclude the others.
The sustained consequence in 35:36-37 may directly unfold the focus seizure or may only provide a later eschatological analogue to a historical event.
The replacement, cosmic-restraint, bounded-flow, and appointed-station readings have visible mechanisms but remain more analogical than the accountability and evidentiary readings.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hastalığın kişiyi tutması düşüncesini verirken göz yangısı, hastalıktan boyun bükme, yavrunun sütten rahatsızlanması, deve veya koyunda delilik benzeri durum ve devede yağlanmaya başlama gibi farklı bedensel halleri de aynı dalda toplar. Bu nedenle dal yalnızca hastalık diye daraltılmamalı, bedende başlayan veya bedeni etkisi altına alan tanıklanmış durumlar kümesi olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir hastalık adı değildir; insan ve hayvanda tanıklanan rahatsızlıklarla devede yağlanmaya başlama durumunu ayrı alt yönler halinde kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Farklı beden durumları yalnızca kendi biçim ve kalıpları içinde korunur; bir alt kullanım bütün dalın genel anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninde belirli bir durumun başlayıp etkisini göstermesini anlatan kullanımlar kümesidir; göz yangısı ve hastalıktan boyun bükme yanında sütten rahatsızlanma, delilik benzeri hayvan hali ve devede yağlanmaya başlama da tanıklanır.

facets.statement: Bir hastalık ya da beden durumunun insanı veya hayvanı etkisi altına almaya başlamasını anlatan genel bağı kurar.
İnsanda göz yangısını ve hastalık ya da ağrı yüzünden başı eğip boyun bükmüş durumu belirtir.
Deve ve koyunda deliliğe benzeyen bir hali, süt emen yavruda ise fazla sütten doğan rahatsızlığı belirtir.
Develerde yağın oluşmaya başlaması, hastalık dışındaki olumlu bir beden değişimi olarak aynı söz ailesinde yer alır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bedeni etkisi altına alan durum fikrini çeşitli insan ve hayvan örnekleriyle genişletir; göz yangısı, hastalıktan çökkünlük, fazla sütten rahatsızlanma, delilik benzeri hal ve yağlanmaya başlama birlikte tanıklanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفارة ما يكفر به من الخطيئة واليمين فيمحى به (ayn)؛ تكفير اليمين فعل ما يجب بالحنث فيها والاسم الكفارة والتكفير في المعاصي (sihah)؛ الكفارة ما يغطي الإثم والتكفير ستره وتغطيته حتى يصير بمنزلة ما لم يعمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üzüm salkımının veya hurma çiçeğinin kılıfı
hurma çiçeğinin ya da meyvenin kılıfı
hurma ağacından çıkan kapalı çiçek kılıfları

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tahıl tanesi örtüsü ve ekinin kılıfa girme durumu, nesne ve gelişim aşaması sınırlarını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور والكفرى والكوافير لأكمام العنب أو طلع النخل أو الورقة التي تستر الثمرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافور الطيب ولا عين الماء ولا النبات ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أكمام الثمر ولا الطلع ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور شيء من أخلاط الطيب والكافور عين ماء في الجنة والكافور نبات نوره كنور الأقحوان (ayn)؛ الكافور من الطيب (sihah)؛ الكافور الذي هو من الطيب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlardan uzak araziyi temel gönderim olarak verir; köy, köyler, bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar anlamları ise aynı söz ailesinin ayrı sözlük kullanımlarıdır. Tanım bunları tek bir 'ıssız yer' nesnesi gibi özdeşleştirmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak arazi çekirdeği ile köy, halk ve mezar kullanımları ayrı facetlerdir; dağ geçidi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzak araziye bağlı söz öbeği ile yalın köy, mezar ve çoğul yer-halk kullanımları ayrı tutulur; kapsamları tek anlamda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlardan uzak, pek inilmez ve geçilmez bir araziyi anlatır. Aynı söz ailesinde köy, köyler veya bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar için kaydedilmiş ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: İnsanlardan uzak, pek uğranmayan veya geçilmeyen arazi.
Köy, köyler ve uzak yerlerin halkı aynı söz ailesinin ayrı yer ve topluluk kullanımlarıdır.
Mezar anlamı tek kaynaklı aktarım içinde verilen ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlardan uzak arazi anlamında birleşir; toplu kanıt ayrıca köy, köylerin halkı ve mezar anlamlarını ortak çekirdekten ayrılması gereken sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.

concept_gloss.text: uzak arazi; köy, uzak yer halkı veya mezar
concept_gloss.applicability: Ana uzak arazi anlamını öne alır ve kaynakta aynı dalda tutulan ayrı yer kullanımlarını açıkça işaretler.

error_profile.preserves: Uzak arazi çekirdeğini; köy, uzak yer halkı ve mezar varyantlarından ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz öbeğinin pek uğranmayan uzak araziyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık ve insan uğrağından yoksunluk özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Köy, halk ve mezar kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanlardan uzak araziyi öne çıkarır ve köy ile mezarı ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü sınırlı yeri; mamur, boş, yerleşik veya ıssız oluşuna bakmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Arazi, köy ve mezar gibi yer gönderimleri iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli sözlük gönderimlerine ve uzaklık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği genel yer kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ana yeri insanlardan uzak arazidir; ayrıca köy ve mezar kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yer adı yanında deniz içindeki veya karadan kopuk adayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan yerleşiminden ya da ana karadan ayrılık düşüncesi iki dalı yakınlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklık insanlarla ilişkilidir; komşu dalda fiziksel kopukluk ve ada yapısı belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yer kavramı ile fiziksel kopuk yer, uzaklık koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر من الأرض البعيد عن الناس والكفور للقرى والكفر للقرية والقبر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الثنايا من الجبال ولا البحر ولا الليل ولا الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر من الأرض ما بعد من الناس وأهل الكفور والقرى (maqayis)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس والكفور القرى (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا القرية والكفر أيضا القبر (sihah)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ geçitlerini, iri bir dağı ve alçak duvarı aynı söz ailesinde sıralar; geçitleri 'örtülü' saymak kaynakta kurucu bir koşul değildir. Dal bu nedenle örtülülük altında birleştirilmeden coğrafi çekirdek ve ayrı duvar kullanımı olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dağ geçidi ve iri dağ coğrafi facetlerdir; alçak duvar ayrı bir sözlük varyantıdır, köy veya uzak arazi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimleri ayrı tutulur; uzak yer veya genel örtme anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağlar arasındaki geçitler veya iri bir dağ için kullanılan coğrafi bir adlandırmadır; aynı söz ailesinde alçak duvar anlamı da ayrı bir sözlük kullanımı olarak kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Dağlar arasındaki geçit veya geçitler.
İri bir dağ, coğrafi alan içindeki ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.
Alçak duvar, coğrafi çekirdekten ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu dağ geçitlerini verir; toplu kanıt iri dağ ve alçak duvar anlamlarını da aynı söz ailesinin ayrı varyantları olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: dağ geçidi; iri dağ veya alçak duvar
concept_gloss.applicability: Dağ geçidi çekirdeğini öne alırken aynı dalda korunan iki ayrı sözlük varyantını da eksiltmeden gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimlerini birbirinden ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul veya tekil biçimin dağlar arasındaki geçidi gösterdiği coğrafi bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazideki geçit gönderimini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dağ geçidi yanında iri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geçidi özellikle dağ veya vadideki yol kıvrımı ve yürünür güzergâh olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazideki geçit iki dalın ortak gönderimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Geçit gönderiminde yakınlık yüksektir; ancak komşu dal yolun kıvrım ve güzergâh yapısını, bu dal ise ayrı dağ ve duvar varyantlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçidin yalnızca dağlık yer türünü adlandırır ve zorluk koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dik, engebeli ve çıkılması güç bir dağ yolunu veya benzer yükseltileri merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazide geçiş sağlayan yer iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeğinde sarplık veya tırmanış şartı yoktur; komşu dalda güç çıkılan yükselen yol belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ geçidi ile sarp dağ yolu, geçit türünün ve zorluk koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفرات والثنايا من الجبال والكفر العظيم من الجبال والحائط الواطئ
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القرية ولا القبر ولا الأرض البعيدة العامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفرات والكفر الثنايا من الجبال (maqayis)؛ الكفر الثنايا من الجبال (ayn)؛ الكفر العظيم من الجبال (sihah)؛ الكافر الحائط الواطىء (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başla işaret etme ile eli göğse koyup bedenini alçaltmayı, başka birine boyun eğme gösterisinin iki bedensel gerçekleşmesi olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel içsel alçakgönüllülük değil, baş veya el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli bir boyun eğme gösterisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adı belirli bedensel boyun eğme hareketleriyle sınırlanır; günah giderme veya kişiyi inançsız sayma anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup bedenini alçaltması yoluyla başka birine boyun eğdiğini göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Bedeni alçaltan bir hareketle başka birine boyun eğme gösterisi yapma.
Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup eğilmesi, bu gösterinin belirtilen bedensel biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başka birine bedensel olarak boyun eğme çekirdeğinde birleşir; başla işaret ve eli göğse koyarak eğilme iki farklı hareket biçimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tutumdan çok baş, el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli gösteriyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel eğilmeyi, yöneldiği kişiyi ve boyun eğme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğmesi
contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğme işareti yaptığı tarihî bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla yaptığı boyun eğme işaretini korur.
error_profile.loses: Elin göğse konduğu ve bütün bedenin alçaldığı biçimi dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: başını eğmek veya elini göğsüne koyup eğilmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başla işaret veya eli göğse koyup eğilme gibi belirli bir kişiye yönelmiş hareketleri şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içsel alçalışı, ses ve bakışın sakinleşmesini, ibadet duruşunu ve genel gönüllü boyun eğmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Başın ve bedenin alçaltılmasıyla boyun eğme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli törensel beden hareketidir; komşu dal daha geniş bir içsel ve dışsal alçakgönüllülük alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda alnı yere koymak şart değildir; baş işareti veya göğüste elle eğilme yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alnı yere koymayı ve secde biçimindeki boyun eğmeyi de çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedeni alçaltarak itaat ve saygı gösterme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hareketin biçimi farklıdır: bu dal ayakta yapılan eğilme işaretlerini, komşu dal yere kapanmaya kadar uzanan secdeyi kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel alçakgönüllülük ve yere kapanma, bu dalın belirli beden hareketi sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التكفير بمعنى إيماء الذمي برأسه أو وضع اليد على الصدر والتطامن خضوعا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تكفير اليمين ولا التكفير عن السيئات ولا نسبة الشخص إلى الكفر
branches.source_phrase_ar: التكفير إيماء الذمي برأسه لا يقال سجد له وإنما يقال كفر له (ayn)؛ التكفير أن يخضع الإنسان لغيره يضع يده على صدره ويتطامن له (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemini hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini açıkça verir; ancak geçici dal imgesindeki tacın örttüğü düşüncesi bir kaynak iddiası değildir. Süreç ve nesne ayrımı korunarak aynı dalda gösterilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hükümdarlık tacı ve taç giydirme töreniyle sınırlıdır; genel baş örtüsü veya boyun eğme hareketi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adının taç giydirme süreci ve taç nesnesi gönderimleri birlikte fakat ayrı facetlerde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemidir; aynı söz bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemi.
Taçlandırma işleminde kullanılan tacın kendisi için aktarılan nesne anlamı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı fakat ayrı gerçekleşme verir: bir şeyi tanınmayacak biçimde değiştirmek ve sevilen bir durumdan hoşlanılmayan bir duruma geçmek. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanınmazlaştırma ile kötüleşme tek bir zorunlu süreçmiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
